remarks: Modern Living  &  Incredible Versatility in the South Bay! Located in a fantastic South Bay neighborhood, this turnkey property features two fully updated independent living spaces on one lot. The primary front residence welcomes you with a spacious open floor plan highlighted by dramatic vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light. It boasts a beautifully remodeled kitchen that transitions effortlessly into the living space, along with two tastefully modernized bathrooms.
